rationale.intuition: Edge case: applicant marked applyingTestOptional=false BUT testScores is empty — i.e. they intended to submit but didn't (incomplete application from admissions reviewer's POV) rather than electing test-optional. 这种情况比真正 TO 更糟: TO is treated as 'I chose not to submit'; missing-but-required reads as 'incomplete / unsubmitted'. Harvard 2025-26 reinstated test requirement — without scores, application is functionally incomplete. Industry: incomplete apps at Ivies rarely admitted (<1%); even with strong rest-of-profile, missing required test signal triggers admissions-reader default to 'cannot evaluate'. 0.005 lower bound reflects incomplete reality; 0.04 upper bound allows engine to treat as TO equivalent (current behavior, which is the gap).

sources.name: Harvard Admissions Office Announcement April 2024
sources.evidence: Harvard reinstated standardized testing requirement for Class of 2029 (RD 2025-26 cycle). Applications without SAT/ACT are flagged as incomplete unless explicitly approved test-waiver category

sources.name: Inside Higher Ed - 'Ivies Bring Back Tests' 2024
sources.evidence: Harvard / Yale / MIT / Brown / Dartmouth all moved off test-optional for 2025-26; applications without test scores at these schools no longer process in the standard reader queue

sources.name: Common App Test-Optional Report 2024
sources.evidence: Engine treats TO with 0.85× modifier at <20% accept schools; this fixture tests whether engine distinguishes 'TO=true / no test' (legitimate TO, 0.85×) from 'TO=false / no test' (incomplete, should be much lower)

wontFix.reason: Engine likely does not distinguish 'applyingTestOptional=false + testScores=[]' (incomplete) from 'applyingTestOptional=true + testScores=[]' (legitimate TO) — both fall through to no-test code path. This fixture exposes the gap: incomplete-application case should be modeled more harshly than self-elected TO.
wontFix.followUp: Add explicit 'incomplete application' detection in counselor engine: if testScores empty AND applyingTestOptional=false AND school requires tests, apply ~0.3× multiplier (not the standard 0.85× TO penalty). Track behavior in upcoming PR for application-completeness modeling.
